subject.title: [Bug]: Scheduled isolated agentTurn outer run records error although session ended success

question: Should successful isolated cron execution followed by delivery-send failure persist as status=ok with deliveryStatus=not-delivered, or should this wait for the broader warning-status contract?
rationale: Current code can represent delivery failure separately, but changing the primary status affects status-only operators, retry/backoff, and alert semantics.

options.title: Accept Narrow Status Split
options.body: Land the focused finalizer fix so successful execution stays ok and delivery failure is surfaced through deliveryStatus and diagnostics.

options.title: Defer To Warning Status
options.body: Keep this issue open behind the broader warning-status work if maintainers want a first-class partial-success cron status.

options.title: Require Upgrade Guidance First
options.body: Ask for explicit docs or release-note guidance for consumers that currently use primary status=error to detect undelivered cron runs.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Status Split
recommendation.body: Land the focused finalizer fix so successful execution stays ok and delivery failure is surfaced through deliveryStatus and diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about cron execution/delivery semantics, and history shows steipete shaped the isolated cron runner and delivery-dispatch boundary.
